item.title: Blood Moon to Light Up the Sky Today: Here’s How to Stream the Lunar Eclipse Live
item.description: The much-awaited Blood Moon 2026 will be visible in India for a brief 15-20 minutes during moonrise. While the eclipse begins in the afternoon, Indian viewers will witness its final phase around sunset. Arunachal Pradesh will see it first.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Suryakumar, Hardik and Dube leave team hotel before Semifinal; Sparks debate
item.description: Controversy erupted ahead of India’s T20 World Cup 2026 semifinal against England after Suryakumar Yadav, Hardik Pandya and Shivam Dube were seen leaving for their homes in Mumbai instead of staying with the team.

item.title: ‘Indian citizens safety in Gulf is our top priority’: MEA
item.description: Their safety and well-being is of utmost priority. We cannot remain impervious to developments that adversely affect them. Our trade and energy supply chains also pass through this region, and any major disruption could have serious consequences for the Indian economy

item.title: 15 MPs nominated to committee of privileges; Ravi Shankar Prasad appointed chairperson
item.description: The newly constituted panel includes Brijmohan Agrawal, Tariq Anwar, Manickam Tagore, T. R. Baalu, Kalyan Banerjee, Shrirang Barne, Ramvir Singh Bidhuri, Sangeeta Kumari Singh Deo, Jagdambika Pal, Trivendra Singh Rawat, Arvind Sawant, Jagadish Shettar, Manish Tewari, and Dharmendra Yadav.

item.title: Manoj Sinha chairs high-level review of Kashmir law and order; Calls for vigilance
item.description: The meeting was attended by senior police and civil administration officials, including Director General of Police Nalin Prabhat, Special DG (Coordination) S J M Gillani, ADGP Armed Anand Jain, ADGP CID Nitish Kumar, IGP Kashmir V K Birdi, Divisional Commissioner Kashmir Anshul Garg, DIG Central Kashmir Range Rajiv Pandey, and Deputy Commissioner Srinagar Akshay Labroo.

item.title: MK Stalin formally signs agreement to allot one Rajya Sabha seat to DMDK
item.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin has formalised an agreement to allocate one Rajya Sabha seat to DMDK, led by Premalatha Vijayakanth. The move strengthens the DMK-led alliance ahead of the 2026 Assembly elections and reshapes the state’s political landscape.

item.title: Assam Elections 2026: Congress Unveils First List of 42 Candidates, Sparks Political Buzz Across the State
item.description: With the 2026 Assam Assembly elections approaching, Congress has released its first list of 42 candidates, intensifying political activity across the state. Strategic selections, prominent faces, and regional balance indicate a high-stakes and fiercely competitive electoral battle ahead.

item.title: Nation drenched in colours as Holi unites millions; Discover unique traditions across states
item.description: Holi 2026 is being celebrated across India with immense joy, colours and devotion. While the spirit of the festival remains the same, each state observes unique traditions - from Lathmar Holi in Uttar Pradesh to Basant Utsav in West Bengal and Rang Panchami in Maharashtra.

item.title: Who is Mojtaba Khamenei? Appointed Iran new Supreme Leader amid regional tensions
item.description: Iran’s Assembly of Experts has appointed Mojtaba Khamenei as the country’s new Supreme Leader following the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. His selection comes amid escalating tensions in West Asia and has sparked debate over alleged support from the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.

item.title: PM Modi to Visit Tiruchy on 11 March for NDA Election Campaign
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Tiruchy district in Tamil Nadu on 11 March to campaign in support of the NDA alliance. The visit was confirmed by Tamil Nadu BJP president Nainar Nagendran.
